segments.sn34.35-40:1.1: 696-701. Sāvatthinidānaṃ …“samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo … samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo … neva samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo hoti, na ca samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo … samādhismiṃ kallitakusalo ca hoti, samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo ca.
segments.sn34.35-40:1.6: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ jhāyī … pe … uttamo ca pavaro cā”ti.
segments.sn34.35-40:1.8: Pañcatiṃsatimaṃ.(Purimamūlakāni viya yāva cattālīsamā kallitamūlakasappāyakārīsuttā cha suttāni pūretabbāni. Kallitamūlakaṃ.)
